intro.title: Your Private Escape to Alpine Bliss: MALIA - Alpine Hideaway
intro.p1: Between mountain and lake, a place emerges for those who seek something special – not in excess, but in essence. MALIA Alpine Hideaway is not a destination for ostentatious luxury, but for something genuine. Clear architecture, natural materials, and a sense of timelessness define the experience. Everything follows one simple idea: less, but better. Here, relaxation happens quietly. In uncluttered spaces, in the vastness of nature, in moments that linger – without haste, without staging.

wellness.title: Wellness Area – A Space for Regeneration
wellness.p1: The wellness area at MALIA is a private retreat. A place where warmth, calmness, and thoughtful design come together.
wellness.p2: Sauna and infrared heat allow the body to unwind, while the freestanding bathtub invites you to let the day fade away slowly.
wellness.p3: Natural materials, soft lighting, and views of the surrounding nature create an atmosphere in which relaxation unfolds effortlessly. No schedule. No distractions.
wellness.p4: Just silence, warmth, and the feeling of truly returning to yourself.

hosts.title: We are your hosts
hosts.p1:
We are Madeleine (23) and Julia (21) – two sisters with a deep love for our homeland and a shared vision:

to transform our family home into MALIA Alpine Hideaway - a place where nature, design, and Tyrolean warmth come together.
hosts.p2: The name <italic>MALIA</italic> is a combination of our names - and it perfectly reflects what this project is about: two sisters, two personalities, one shared passion. Madeleine is the creative mind between us. With a keen sense for aesthetics, spatial harmony, and atmosphere, she brings every corner to life. Julia, on the other hand, contributes structure, planning and a rational perspective. Together, we complement each other perfectly.
hosts.p3: Our home is <bold>a place close to our hearts</bold>. It is set right in the heart of nature, exactly where we grew up – surrounded by mountains, forests, and fresh alpine air. A special inspiration for us was our <bold>grandfather</bold>, who realized his own dream early on and became a hotelier. From him, we learned what it truly means to host with passion and to build something of your own with dedication.
hosts.p4: With a great deal of personal effort, attention to detail, and strong family support, something truly special is taking shape here: A <bold>modern Hideaway</bold> defined by <bold>natural wood, expansive glass fronts</bold>, and soft <bold>natural tones</bold> that radiate warmth and calm. A place where you <bold>arrive, take a deep breath</bold>, and <bold>feel at home</bold>.
hosts.p5: Our vision is to offer guests an <bold>authentic alpine experience</bold> – the mountains, the lake, the clear air, good food, and that unique feeling of recharging in nature. We want our guests to truly feel life here – whether skiing in the Alps, strolling through the valley, or simply watching the sun rise behind the peaks from the window.
hosts.p6:
We want moments to be created here that last – shared time with family and friends, laughter, quiet, and a deep connection to nature.

Welcome to MALIA Alpine Hideaway – where tradition meets the new, passion meets design, and Tyrolean charm meets genuine hospitality.

location.title: Location & Arrival
location.subtitle: Your journey to MALIA Alpine Hideaway
location.p1: <bold>MALIA - Alpine Hideaway</bold> is located in Pertisau at Achensee, in the heart of one of Tyrol’s most beautiful regions – surrounded by mountains, forests, and crisp alpine air. The mountain cable car is just a two-minute walk away - perfect for those who want to head straight to the slopes in winter or ascend into the alpine heights with the Karwendelbahn in summer. Despite the peaceful setting, the Achensee as well as charming cafés and restaurants can be reached by foot within just a few minutes. Our hideaway combines the best of both worlds: natural tranquillity and close proximity to local life.
location.p2: Arriving with multiple cars is no problem – we provide ample covered parking spaces free of charge.
location.p3: Travelling without a car is also easy. The nearest railway station is <bold>Jenbach</bold>, only about 15 minutes from Lake Achensee.
location.closing: We wish you a pleasant and safe journey!

winter.title: Winter at Lake Achensee
winter.p1:
In winter, Lake Achensee becomes quiet.

Not empty - but gently still.

Snow softens every sound, the mountains feel closer, the days clearer.

Whether it’s a ski tour, a few turns on the slopes, cross-country skiing through the valleys,

or simply a walk through fresh snow – nothing is required, everything is possible. After a day outdoors, you return to MALIA.

Into warmth.
winter.p2:
You take off your boots, settle in, step into the sauna,

or simply sit and look outside. The fireplace crackles, darkness slowly falls, and everyday life suddenly feels very far away.

0.title: Relaxed Ski Days
0.desc: Several ski areas nearby offer variety without the crowds. Pertisau is perfect for relaxed family ski days, the Rofan offers longer runs with breathtaking views, and Christlum is ideal for those who prefer a more sporty pace. Skiing as it should be: uncomplicated, close, and unhurried.

1.title: Cross-Country Skiing at Lake Achensee
1.desc: Around Achensee, cross-country ski trails wind quietly through meadows, forests, and the Karwendel. In and around Pertisau and the Karwendel nature reserve alone, around 80 kilometres of groomed trails await. Across the entire Achensee region, you’ll find more than 200 kilometres of trails - for both classic cross-country skiing and skating. You glide through snow-covered landscapes, hearing only your breath and the soft crunch of snow beneath your skis.

2.title: Sledding, when it gets dark
2.desc: Several natural toboggan runs await around Lake Achensee – short or long, gentle or a little faster. Many are illuminated and invite you to head out again in the evening. Tobogganing under a star-filled sky – simple, honest, and surprisingly beautiful.

3.title: Higher Up
3.desc: If you love ski tourings, you'll find ideal conditions in the Rofan and Karwendel mountains. Snow-covered peaks, clear lines in the snow, and wide-open views – whether you go alone or with a guide. At the summit, everything becomes quiet, and that silence makes every step worthwhile.

lake.title: The Lake during winter
lake.desc:
Even in winter, Lake Achensee is there. Still, vast, and clear.

Winter walks along the shore, crisp air, sparkling snow – a place to breathe deeply and pause, right between mountain and water.
lake.btn: GET YOUR OFFER FOR QUIET LUXURY IN WINTER

summer.title: Summer at Lake Achensee
summer.p1:
In summer, Lake Achensee reveals itself as expansive, clear, and full of life.

Between mountains and water, you’ll find space for movement, lightness, and days that don’t feel busy — but free.

You decide how much "outdoors" you want. Or how little.

0.title: Time for the Outdoors
0.desc: Around MALIA, summer begins right outside your door. In the Karwendel and Rofan mountains, hiking trails lead through forests, across alpine pastures, and up to quiet viewpoints. With every step, your mind feels lighter, your rhythm calmer. You set off, pause, and take it in. Cool your feet in a mountain stream, breathe in the clear air — and realize how little it takes to be fully present.

1.title: Biking Between Mountains & Lake
1.desc: Lake Achensee is a quiet favorite for mountain bikers and e-bikers. Over 250 kilometers of marked trails lead through the Karwendel, Rofan, and the Vorkarwendel — from relaxed lakeside routes to demanding climbs. Whether sporty or leisurely with an e-bike: you move through a landscape that offers space without ever being loud.
1.link: Mountainbiking & Cycling at Lake Achensee | Summer Holiday Tyrol
1.link2: Anmeldung zum Halbmarathon: Achenseelauf | Tirols Panoramalauf erleben

2.title: Golf with a View
2.desc: Just a few steps from MALIA lies the Golf & Landclub Achensee — the oldest golf course in Tyrol, nestled between the Karwendel mountains and the lake. The 18-hole course in Pertisau combines tranquility with playful challenge. Gentle terrain, clean lines, and views that accompany every swing.

3.title: Running & Walking
3.desc: Around the lake, you'll find routes for running, jogging, and Nordic walking. Sometimes flat along the water, sometimes more challenging towards the mountains. You move through open landscapes, hear the water, feel the ground beneath your feet — and run not against time, but with it.
3.link: Running at Achensee | Running holiday Tyrol

4.title: On the Rocks
4.desc: The Rofan and Karwendel ranges are among Tyrol's most diverse climbing areas. Sport climbing, via ferratas, or alpine routes — all set within a landscape that demands respect and rewards it. For beginners and experienced climbers alike, there are routes, courses, and guided tours. The view from above: vast. The moment: clear.
4.link: Climbing at Lake Achensee | Holiday in Tyrol, Austria

5.title: Encounters that Slow You Down
5.desc: For those seeking something even calmer, experience the landscape on an alpaca hike. Slow steps, gentle animals, open paths. You walk through nature, accompany — or are accompanied — and take home a lasting sense of calm.
5.link: Alpaca walk in Tyrol at beautiful Lake Achensee - Achensee-Alpaca

6.title: Cattle Drive at Lake Achensee
6.desc: When autumn arrives, it is time for the return to Lake Achensee: The cows move from the alpine pasture back to their stalls. The cattle drives take place here from mid-September to early October. More detailed information can be found here:
6.link: Cattle drives at Lake Achensee | Tyrol Austria

7.title: Water Sports
7.desc: Water lovers take note, Lake Achensee has a lot to offer: from sailing, kite or windsurfing, to stand-up paddling, kayaking and diving. All information can be found here:
7.link: Water sports in Tyrol | Summer holiday at Lake Achensee

map.title: Interactive Map
map.subtitle: Easy Orientation
map.p1: With the interactive map of the Achensee region, finding your way is effortless – even before you arrive and while you're here. Discover (winter)hiking trails, lakeside walks, routes through the Karwendel, and tours in the Rofan – from gentle to more challenging.
map.p2: All routes are clearly displayed and complemented by helpful information on trail profiles, places to stop for refreshments, and points of interest. Plan your days the way they feel right to you: spontaneous or well prepared, active or deeply relaxed.
map.btn: → View the interactive map of the Achensee region

atoll.title: Atoll Achensee
atoll.p1: Just a few minutes drive from MALIA, Atoll Achensee is located in Maurach. Expansive glass surfaces, clean architecture. And sweeping views across Achensee define the entire complex. Particularly impressive is the rooftop infinity pool, offering a panoramic view of the lake stretching across its full length.
atoll.p2: In addition to the water world with sports and leisure pools, the Penthouse Spa invites you to unwind and recharge. Various saunas, a steam bath, quiet relaxation areas, and a rooftop outdoor space create room for rest and recovery - always with a view.
atoll.p3: For those seeking movement, the Lakeside Gym, bouldering hall, and sports areas offer a wide range of options. Everything is generously designed, everything connected to the surrounding landscape.
atoll.p4: The Atoll is not a must. But it's a beautiful addition - for days when you're drawn to water, warmth, or movement before returning to the calm of MALIA.

Privacy.contact_text: If you contact us via the form on our website or via email, your provided data will be stored by us for the purpose of processing the request and in case of follow-up questions. We do not pass on this data without your consent.
Privacy.cookies_text1: Our website strictly uses technically necessary cookies that are essential for the operation of the website. We do <bold>not</bold> use any analysis or tracking tools (like Google Analytics) and no advertising cookies.
Privacy.cookies_text2: No personal data is passed on to third parties for advertising purposes. The use of our website is therefore possible without a cookie consent banner.
Privacy.stripe_text: If you make a booking or purchase a voucher via our website, payment processing is handled by the payment provider Stripe. For this purpose, payment-relevant data (such as name, address, account info/credit card number) is transmitted directly to Stripe. We do not store any sensitive credit card data on our own servers.
Privacy.rights_text: In principle, you have the right to information, correction, deletion, restriction, data portability, revocation, and objection regarding your stored data. If you believe that the processing of your data violates data protection laws or if your data protection claims have otherwise been violated in any way, you can lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority. In Austria, this is the Data Protection Authority.
